criteria.name: Artwork craft & genuine detail
criteria.notes: The craft cycle landed about half of what it was aimed at. Real gains: 04's horizontal bare band is gone and contours now cover the whole land, so both lettered regions are modelled. 07's bars have a bright top-front arris and a top-face sweep, so they read as lit objects rather than flat bone. 08's window is recessed, with a mullion and bloom, there is a lit roof-edge line, and the piles have dark contacts. On 05 the upward faces of the near rubble take snow and the edges read teal, so the ridge now reads as ice more than stone. What did not land: 03's stray teal arc is still drawn across the top edge (crop slide-03-r1c2, a clean arc from about design y 80 at left to y 40 at right over a dark band), so the basin ramp didn't remove it. 06 still has a dark vertical fin rising above the cable's far bend (crop slide-06-r2c2, at about tile x 170 to 215, y 80 to 170), so ending the path at z 24 didn't kill the stub, and the lower 35 percent is still eventless olive. 04's blocky, stair-stepped white raster patches at lower right are still there behind the counter (crop slide-04-r3c2). 07's hoarfrost 'point sparkles' still read as short diagonal dashes or rain at 2x zoom (crop slide-07-r3c1). 05's large slabs are still dark, opaque, low-poly navy, with the snow mostly on the small rubble, and the near snow is a soft blotchy plane. 08's station end face is still a flat blue-grey panel. The rendered ladder is still climbed on 05 and 06, with ray-cast fields on 01, 08 and 09 and a globe raymarch on 02. This is strong overall, with four frames that still carry findable artifacts. It is above r1's 7.0 but well under the 8.5 floor.
